False positive: CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection issue in Jakarta Mail. opal-maintenance-service only resolves org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation transitively from JAXB/Hibernate, and does not resolve Angus Mail / SMTP providers on runtime, test, or functional classpaths.

CVE-2026-54515 is fixed in com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind 2.21.5/2.22.1, but those patched 2.x artifacts are not currently resolvable from Maven Central. The vulnerable 2.x Jackson line is pulled in transitively by springdoc-openapi/swagger while Spring Boot 4 also provides the patched tools.jackson 3.1.4 line. Remove this suppression once springdoc/swagger or a resolvable com.fasterxml.jackson patched version is available.

Reviewed 2026-08-10. CVE-2026-66299 is a Low severity DoS in the Tomcat WebSocket chat example. Apache lists the fix under Tomcat 11.0.25, but that release is not currently available in Maven Central. This service embeds Tomcat and does not ship Tomcat's examples web application, so the vulnerable example is not part of the deployed application. Keep this suppression only for Tomcat 11.0.24 embed artifacts until a released Tomcat 11.0.25 or later is available.
